items.summary: Disposition: blocked. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not authorize public beta, full launch, affiliate/advertising expansion, external rights outreach, or a go-live proposal. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms point against commercial/public data use. All four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open. Non-legal gates for accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security/release are blocked. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Recommendation: preserve private gate, continue bounded read-only evidence work, and route rights, privacy, jurisdiction, vendor/DPA, and future monetization questions to human counsel before owner-authorized outreach or launch change.

Tracking remains active with 0 of 4 SearchWoot legal tasks evidenced to closure. Existing artifacts partially cover data flow (backend/api/main.py, backend/services/fetcher.py, config.yml) and privacy/cookie pages, but do not establish retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor/DPA coverage, or jurisdictional treatment. Next evidence action: produce one dated read-only evidence bundle containing the four task deliverables and field-level Woot rights matrix; do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, or change the private gate.

Produce the smallest next evidence artifact: a dated table covering source fields and rights, alert-data flow and retention, deployed consent/GA4 configuration, log fields and vendor handling, with explicit unknowns and counsel-required items. Use existing repository/configuration and authorized metadata only; no production mutation or duplicate telemetry request.
